personal.title: IT Product & Project Manager, PMP
personal.abstract: IT Product & Project Manager with 8+ years in IT and project delivery, bridging technology and business to deliver measurable impact. I lead complex software initiatives end-to-end — from product vision to release — across Agile, Hybrid, and Waterfall methodologies, having managed 18–22 concurrent projects and 3 SaaS products in highly regulated environments. Skilled at turning technical challenges into actionable business solutions, optimizing processes, mitigating risk, and driving digital transformation across SMEs and enterprise organizations.

experience.title: Product Manager
responsibilities: Lead end-to-end product management for 3 SaaS products in highly regulated environments, owning feature definition, release, and roadmap prioritization
Author product features, acceptance criteria, test plans, and release changelogs, keeping engineering, QA, and business stakeholders aligned on every delivery
Define technical and business requirements with engineering and validate API specifications using Swagger, Postman, and Apidog
Established automated QA and governance practices (Robot Framework, API validation, UI testing), making quality a repeatable, scalable process across releases
Coordinate agile workflows and release cycles across multiple teams using Azure DevOps and Wrike
Pilot AI/LLM-assisted automation to streamline validation and documentation workflows

experience.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Delivered a portfolio of 18–22 concurrent projects end-to-end for large enterprise clients, consistently meeting scope, timeline, and compliance targets
Managed delivery in complex, regulated environments, ensuring alignment across business, compliance, and technical teams
Applied Waterfall, Hybrid, and Agile methodologies to drive effective delivery and change management
Translated business needs and stakeholder expectations into clear project objectives, monitoring regulatory updates throughout

experience.title: Project Consultant
responsibilities: Led digital-transformation initiatives modernizing client processes across e-invoicing, ERP, EDI, WMS, CRM, and eCommerce
Analyzed business requirements and designed solutions aligned to customer workflows, implementing PEPPOL and MyData compliance standards
Partnered with development teams to translate business needs into technical tasks and deliver seamless API integrations
